entities.name: Nikya
entities.description: Powerful centaur druid and leader of the Gruul Zhur-Taa Clan on Ravnica.

entities.name: Zhur-Taa Clan
entities.description: Gruul tribe led by Nikya that worships the ancient gods of old Ravnica.

entities.name: Ilharg
entities.description: The Raze-Boar, expected bringer of the End-Raze.

entities.name: End-Raze
entities.description: Expected apocalypse in which Ravnica's cities fall and the world returns to nature.

entities.name: Cecilee
entities.description: Selesnyan druid who ran a vernadi in the Rubblebelt and adopted a Gruul infant.

entities.name: Ruzi
entities.description: Cecilee's brother, who disowned his Selesnyan affiliation and lied to Nikya.

entities.name: Massacre Girl
entities.description: Rakdos war party leader who killed Cecilee.

entities.name: Rakdos
entities.description: Guild whose war party attacked the vernadi.

entities.name: Kal
entities.description: Gruul shaman who cast an Izzet rebounding fire spell.

entities.name: Golgari Swarm
entities.description: Guild bottled up by Nikya's vines during the New Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Rubblebelt
entities.description: Area of Ravnica where the vernadi stood.

events.summary: Nikya diplomatically asks Cecilee for the Gruul infant back; Cecilee refuses and Nikya severs ties with the Selesnyans.
events.quote: Cecilee refused to give up the infant

events.summary: A Rakdos war party led by Massacre Girl attacks the vernadi, slaughters its people and Massacre Girl cuts Cecilee's throat.
events.quote: Massacre Girl cut the druid's throat herself

events.summary: Ruzi finds Zi, disowns Selesnya, and lies to Nikya that the infant was killed.
events.quote: lying to her that the deaths included the innocent Gruul child

events.summary: Nikya declares war on the Rakdos; Kal's fire spell kills nearly all of them though Massacre Girl escapes, and Nikya claims the bloodwitch's head.
events.quote: Nikya declared war upon the Rakdos raiding party

events.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion Nikya bottlenecks the Golgari Swarm from the surface with vine magic.
events.quote: Nikya was instrumental in bottlenecking the Golgari Swarm

relations.quote: leader of the Gruul Zhur-Taa Clan on Ravnica

relations.note: went to war with her troops
relations.quote: to do battle with Massacre Girl's troops
Massacre Girl cut the druid's throat herself

relations.note: only real potential challenge to his power
relations.quote: the only real potential challenge to Borborygmos 's power as guildmaster of the Gruul
